3. Put solders [1.6 mm (0.063 inch) diameter, about 10 mm 
(0.39 inch) long] on the transaxle case at the positions 
shown in the illustration.
4. Install the bearing outer races of the differential and output 
shaft.
5. Install the transaxle case and tighten the bolts to the 
specified torque.
Tightening torque: 44 ± 5 N⋅m (33 ± 4 ft-lb)
6. Remove the transaxle case.
7. Remove the outer races and take out the crushed solders.
8. Measure the thickness of the crushed solder with a 
micrometer and select spacers that will provide the standard 
end play/preload value.
Standard value: 
Input shaft end play: 0.05 − 0.17 mm (0.0020 − 0.0067 
inch)
Output shaft preload: 0.13 − 0.18 mm (0.0051 − 
0.0071 inch)
Differential preload: 0.05 − 0.11 mm (0.0020 − 0.0043 
inch)
